title: Intake detector: work commits whose KB-Work git does not read
goal: intake's trailer detector reads origin/main's commits of the last TRAILER_WINDOW_DAYS and reports one bug per set of commits whose body has a KB-Work line that git reads as no trailer, or that change _tools/, .claude/, .githooks/ or .gitlab-ci.yml with no KB-Work trailer and no KB-Auto trailer; the fingerprint is the sorted short shas

gates.question: How far back does the trailer detector read origin/main (TRAILER_WINDOW_DAYS)?
options: since the newest commit an open intake bug names
gates.recommendation: 7: older commits are history and stay as they are (backlog.md, Git)
